hook: Tech giants love a bold moment. Let's rank the craziest ones from Apple and Microsoft.
outro: Mac or PC? Drop your pick below and subscribe!

items.line: Bill Gates himself demoed Windows 98 live on stage, and it blue-screened in front of everyone. Iconic, unscripted, humiliating. C-Tier, the crash heard around the world.

Microsoft literally disguised Windows Vista as a fake new OS called Mojave and showed it to people who hated Vista, and they loved it. Genius reveal, but also admitting their own product's reputation was unsalvageable. B-Tier, brilliant and humiliating at once.
Apple's 'Get a Mac' campaign ran for four years straight, just two guys in a room making PCs look hopeless. Simple, brutal, effective. A-Tier, dragged their rival for half a decade.

But Apple's '1984' ad only aired once during the Super Bowl and it's still called the greatest commercial ever made, a woman smashing Big Brother on screen to launch a computer. S-Tier, advertising as art.
